subject: Aurora Systems – Launch stewardship & staging owners
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@aurorasystems.com>, Samantha Lee <s.lee@aurorasystems.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Systems – Launch stewardship & staging owners

Hi Ari / Samantha —

Congrats again on signing. Quick note to hand this off internally and align on the immediate steps so the implementation has clear owners and no surprises. Summary and asks below.

Deal snapshot (short):
- Product: Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated reserved capacity for burst windows
- Committed start: targeted pilot week of 2027-08-08 (pilot window 2 weeks)
- MRR / Commit: see SOW (attached)
- Primary success criteria: 1) Pilot passes throughput test (10k tokens/sec sustained for 95th pct), 2) No PII leakage in eval prompts, 3) Integration with Aurora staging tenant and RBAC completed

Attachments and links:
- Aurora-Implementation-Plan-v1.xlsx (attached) — sequencing for sprint0 + dependencies
- Signed SOW (Aurora-SOW-signed-20270714.pdf) — commercial terms and milestones
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/aurora-launch-4821
- HubSpot: https://hub.redwood.example/deals/4821

High-level timeline (proposed):
1) 2027-07-26 — internal CS kickoff and staffing confirmation
2) 2027-07-29 — technical kickoff with Aurora (API keys, staging access)
3) 2027-08-08 — pilot start

Key risks / open items we want to track:
- Staging network: Aurora wants a private peering test during pilot (may require infra/NetOps). Contact: Samantha
- Security questionnaire: Aurora submitted a custom data retention ask — security team requested clarifications (I've flagged to support)
- Dedicated capacity sizing: default pool may need a memory-optimized GPU for their large context. We should decide quantization vs dedicated slot.

Asks for the Redwood internal team:
- Marissa / Hannah: please propose a primary CS owner and back-up who will run pilot success and weekly checkpoints.
- Ben: procurement/ops notes for Dedicated capacity sizing and any expected ramp costs — please call out required approvals.
- Tessa: runbook alignment and acceptance criteria owner

Ari / Samantha — if the above looks right, please confirm the two-week pilot window and whether your staging tenant will be available by 7/29.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Aurora-Implementation-Plan-v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: Aurora-SOW-signed-20270714.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: Aurora Systems – Launch stewardship & staging owners

Thanks Stephanie — I can take primary ownership for the pilot and will assign Monica Patel as the day-to-day implementation lead. Monica will be the primary CS contact for Aurora and will run the weekly checkpoints.

Initial notes / commitments from CS perspective:
- Monica (monica_patel@redwood.ai) will schedule the internal CS kickoff on 2027-07-26.
- We'll own the pilot acceptance checklist and weekly status (success criteria, blocking bugs, performance metrics).
- For the peering/network ask: Hannah will coordinate with infra (cc'd).

Open questions for Aurora (cc Ari / Samantha):
1) Who on your side will be the technical PM for the staging tenant? We need a single point to coordinate access and peering windows.
2) Can you confirm whether your staging environment permits the test that sustains 10k tokens/sec, or do we need to run a synthetic load on our dedicated pool?

I'll pick an internal secondary (Tessa will be backup for owner coverage during Monica's planned PTO in early Sept).

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks — quick procurement/ops notes:
- Dedicated capacity sizing: based on Aurora's projected initial throughput, recommend reserving a 4-GPU memory-optimized pool for the first 30 days then re-evaluate. That avoids immediate throttling during pilot.
- Cost: estimate ~15k/month incremental for that pool during the initial month; I can add line items into the onboarding cost tracker.
- Approvals: Karthik (cc) should confirm finance path for the initial reserve.

I'll add a short ops checklist for Monica that includes quota increases, k8s ingress rules for peering, and an owner for monitoring alerts.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

Perfect — thank you all.

Monica: welcome aboard as primary. Please confirm the internal kickoff slot for 7/26 (I suggest 10:00 PT) and post a calendar invite that includes the Drive folder + SOW link.

Monica's first deliverables (please aim to complete before 7/29):
- Finalized pilot acceptance checklist (deliverable owner: monica_patel)
- Access matrix for staging (who needs keys, scoped RBAC, duration)
- Short ops/monitoring runbook (alerts, escalation path)

Ari / Samantha — once Monica posts the kickoff invite, feel free to add your technical PM and any additional attendees. We'll have an internal prep slot with infra / ops 30 minutes prior to the customer kickoff to confirm peering windows.
